senses.gloss:
नुद् 1. नुद्, cl. 6. P. A. नुदति, -ते, नुनोद,
नुनुदे, नोत्स्यति, -ते, अनौत्सीत्, अनुत्त,
नोत्तुम्, to push, push on, impel, incite, propel, urge
on, push away, drive away, repel, banish; to move,
remove; to throw, shoot, cast, send; to raise, lift up
(Ved.): Caus. नोदयति, -यितुम्, to push on, incite,
excite: Intens. नोनुद्यते, नोनोत्ति, to push or impel
or drive away repeatedly; [cf. Angl. Sax. nyd-ian,
‘to compel;’ a-nydan, ‘to repel;’ niot-an: Goth.
niut-an: perhaps Gr. νύσσα.]

2. नुद्, त्, त्, त् (at the end of a comp.), driving
away, removing, rejecting, repelling.

नुद, अस्, आ, अम् (at the end of a comp.), pushing,
impelling, driving away, removing.

नूद नूद, अस्, m. the mulberry tree,
Morus Indica.
नुदत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, urging forward.
नुदित, अस्, आ, अम्, (ep.) = नुत्त, नुन्न.
